steps_webp-to-png_1Desc: Select a WebP image. Converting to PNG gives you lossless quality and transparency support — ideal for graphics, logos, and editing workflows.
steps_webp-to-png_2Desc: PNG uses mathematically lossless compression. Every pixel from your WebP is preserved exactly — the tradeoff is a larger file size than WebP.
steps_webp-to-png_3Desc: Click Convert to get a lossless PNG. Perfect for when you need the highest fidelity version of your image for further editing.
